One Builder proposed: the world is not one.
They raised a Nether portal of cobblestone and obsidian —
A pool of violet light churned across the ground.
The villagers hesitated a long while, then chose to send their young ones along to see.
Seas of lava, canyons of soul sand, Wither skeletons in the fortresses…
The first expedition came back gutted.
Fewer than one in three returned.
Many stayed in the Nether forever.
They swore never to open the portal again.
But the Builders' curiosity did not stop.
They wanted to know what the Nether truly was, and why it was so deadly.
